---
title: "Mann-Whitney U test"
---

```{r, include=FALSE}
library(exams)
library(mathml)
library(htmltools)
library(mistakes)


ustat <- function(a, b)
  cardinality(outer(a, b, FUN=">"))

cardinality <- sum


task <- "mannwhitney1"
plfile <- file.path("rexams", sprintf("%s.pl", task))
rolog::consult(system.file(plfile, package="mistakes"))


## DATA GENERATION
repeat
{
  n_a <- 5L
  n_b <- 6L

  x <- sample(10:99, n_a + n_b, replace=FALSE)

  a <- sort(x[1:n_a])
  b <- sort(x[(n_a + 1):(n_a + n_b)])
  u <- sum(outer(a, b, ">"))
  a_win <- sum(sapply(a, function(x) any(x > b)))

  if(u <= 2)
    next
  if(u >= n_a*n_b - 2)
    next

  Q <- quote(search(mannwhitney1, mannwhitney1(a, b, n_a, n_b, a_win),
                  .S, .R, .P, .E))

  S <- findall(Q, options=list(preproc=as.rolog), env=environment())

  if(problems(S))
    next

  break
}

t <- prepare(task=task, S)
sol <- format_feedback(t$correct, t$explanations, t$praise, t$blame, t$extra)
```

Question
========

Two independent groups have the following observations:

Group A: `r paste(a, collapse=", ")`

Group B: `r paste(b, collapse=", ")`

There are no ties. Determine the Mann-Whitney $U$-statistic.

```{r questionlist, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
answerlist(t$alternatives, markup="markdown")
```

Solution
========
The Mann-Whitney $U$-statistic for Group A is calculated by counting 
all pairwise comparison won by Group A: `r t$solution`


```{r solutionlist, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
sol <- lapply(sol, FUN=gsub, pattern="\\n", replacement="")
answerlist(sol, markup="markdown")
```
